description: Land Title Settlement Department - Mailawalana, Dompe D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No. 511000 and other Title Settlements
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registrations and determinations under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed schedules of specific land parcels, their owners, property details, and encumbrances. The content is focused entirely on land and property matters, falling squarely within the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) which covers land registrations, property ownership, land titles, and related administrative determinations.
